Container.Name: checkarr
Container.Overview: A self-hosted dashboard that periodically polls your media stack (Radarr, Sonarr, Lidarr, Whisparr, Chaptarr, Prowlarr, Plex, Jellyfin, Immich, qBittorrent, Deluge, rTorrent, ruTorrent, Seerr, Jellyseerr, Dispatcharr, Sportarr, Cleanuparr, iPlayarr, iPlayer-Arr, or any other HTTP service) and shows one consolidated view of what's healthy, what's degraded, and why.

Config.Name: Secret Key
Config.Description: Fixed Fernet key for encrypting stored API keys.

Config.Name: Default poll interval
Config.Description: Default poll interval for services that don't override it.

Config.Name: HTTP Basic Auth Username
Config.Description: Set both to require HTTP Basic Auth on the admin app (port 8080). Unset means no auth, fine on a trusted LAN.

Config.Name: HTTP Basic Auth Password
Config.Description: Set both to require HTTP Basic Auth on the admin app (port 8080). Unset means no auth, fine on a trusted LAN.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: UID for permissions. Do not change unless you know what you're doing.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: GID for permissions. Do not change unless you know what you're doing.

Config.Name: UMASK
Config.Description: UMASK for newly created files. Do not change unless you know what you're doing.
